name: Rectangular Heuristic
definition: A load balancing technique that partitions the image plane into rectangular regions by organizing processors into a 2D M x K mesh, dividing the image into M horizontal bands and then K vertical bands within each band to improve scalability over 1D horizontal division.
summary: The Rectangular Heuristic is a parallel volume rendering load-balancing method that partitions the image plane into rectangular regions using a 2D processor mesh to improve workload distribution.
